# COPILOT INSTRUCTIONS — HIGH IMPORTANCE

DO NOT PUSH TO REMOTE WITHOUT EXPLICIT USER APPROVAL

This repository-level instruction must be followed by the Copilot CLI, any subagents, and automation acting on this repository.

1) NEVER run `git push` or otherwise push commits to any remote (GitHub, GitLab, etc.) for this repository unless the repository owner/maintainer has given an explicit, unambiguous approval command such as:
   - "Push to origin main now"
   - "Approve push: push my pending commits"

2) It is acceptable to:
   - create, edit, stage, and commit changes locally
   - show diffs and staging status to the user
   - request explicit approval to push

3) When in doubt, DO NOT PUSH. Ask the user for explicit permission.

User quote (verbatim):
"never ever EVER push to github without checking with me first. ... when i am satisfied with the results i will explicitly request a push to github."

This file is intentionally stored in the repo so the CLI reads it. Do not remove or override without direct user instruction.

-- End of high-importance instruction --
